q: Richard Allen yazaalibwa wa, era mu mbeera ki?
a: Yazaalibwa mu buddu nga February 14, 1760, mu kibuga Philadelphia; nannyini ye eyasooka yali Benjamin Chew, munnamateeka omumanyifu Omu-Quaker. Allen bwe yali akyali mulenzi, ab'omu maka ge bonna — nnyina, kitaawe, n'abaana — baatundibwa ne batwalibwa ewa omulimi ayitibwa Stokeley Sturgis, okumpi ne Dover mu nsi ya Delaware. Eyo omutandisi wa kkanisa esooka ey'Abaddugavu eyeeyimirizaawo mu Amerika yakulira mu ssomero erisinga obwangu n'obuzibu, ng'ayiga ng'akyali muto amakulu g'okuba ow'omusajja omulala; yajjukiranga Sturgis nga mukama ow'ekisa, naye n'awandiika nti "obuddu kkerezi ekaawa, newankubadde nga twalina mukama omulungi."

Allen bwe yali ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na musanvu, omubuulizi Omumesodisiti yajja mu kitundu, era omuddu omuvubuka n'agenda okumuwuliriza. Abamesodisiti mu myaka egyo baali bantu abanyiikivu abaatambulanga nga babuulira eri buli eyandiwulirizza — abaavu, abaddu, n'abagobebwa — era obubaka bwabwe bwatuuka butereevu ku mutima gwe. Ng'alumirizibwa nnyo olw'ekibi, yakaabiriranga Katonda emisana n'ekiro, ng'akolerera mu nnimiro emisana era ng'alwanira mu kusaba ekiro, okutuusa akawungeezi kamu omugugu lwe gwamenyeka: "amangu ago ekkomera lyange ne likankana, enjegere zange ne zigwa, era ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda, ne nkaaba. Omwoyo gwange ne gujjula."

q: Mukama we yatuuka atya okumuwa eddembe?
a: Allen yafuna olukusa okukubiriza enkuŋŋaana z'Abamesodisiti mu nnyumba y'oku faamu yennyini, era olunaku lumu omubuulizi omutambuze Freeborn Garrettson n'abuulira ng'ava mu kitabo kya Danyeeri ku bigambo nti "wapimibwa mu minzaani n'osangibwa ng'obulako," n'abissa awatali kutya ku basajja abaakwatanga bannaabwe mu buddu. Ekigambo ne kituuka mu mutima: Stokeley Sturgis n'akakasa nti okuba n'abaddu kibi eri Katonda, era n'awa Allen ne muganda we omukisa okwegula bokka. Oyo eyasabira omwoyo gwa mukama we yandifulumye ng'omuntu ow'eddembe kubanga okusaba kwe kwasooka kutuuka ku mukama we.

Endagaano yali ya pawundi nkaaga eza zaabu ne ffeeza — doola enkumi bbiri mu ssente ez'omu mulembe ogw'Obujeemu ezaali zigudde omuwendo — nga beegula obudde bwabwe n'entuuyo zaabwe. Okumala emyaka egy'okupangisibwa ng'omupakasi, ng'asala enku, ng'atikka amatoffaali, era ng'avuga eggaali ery'omunnyo ery'eggye, Allen yamaliriza okusasula. Okutuuka mu 1783 ebbanja lyali liweddewo era Richard Allen, ku nkomerero, yali wa ddembe mu maaso g'amateeka, ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu. Yali yeebala ng'omuntu wa ddembe mu ngeri esinga obuziba emyaka mingi ng'amateeka tegannakikkiriza, okuva ku ssaawa enjegere ze lwe zaagwa mu nnimiro y'e Delaware.

q: Obulamu bwe ng'omubuulizi omutambuze bwali butya?
a: Eddembe gy'ali tekyategeeza kuwummula wabula kutumibwa. Yakwata oluguudo, ng'atambula era ng'eyimirizaawo ng'ayita mu Delaware, New Jersey, Pennsylvania ne Maryland, ng'eyisaawo n'emirimu gya buli lunaku era ng'abuulira buli oluggi we lwaggulirwanga — mu bisaawe, mu bibira, ne mu nkuŋŋaana ez'omu nsiisira. Yeetaba mu Christmas Conference ey'ebyafaayo eya 1784 mu Baltimore, Obumesodisiti bw'Amerika mwe bwetegekera okuba ekkanisa, era n'ategeeragana ne Bishop Francis Asbury, eyamuyita omulundi gumu batambulire wamu mu bitundu eby'obuddu — kye Allen yagaana, kubanga teyayagala kusirisibwa ku nsonga y'obuddu.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo mu St. George's Methodist Church?
a: Mu 1786 Allen yayitibwa okubuulira eri abaddugavu abaali mu St. George's mu Philadelphia, era wansi w'okufuba kwe omuwendo gwabwe ne gweyongera mangu. Ekibiina ky'abaddugavu bwe kyeyongera obungi, abakulembeze abazungu ne batandika okweraliikirira, ne babajjulula okuva ku ntebe zaabwe eza bulijjo ne babassa ku mabbali g'ekisenge, oluvannyuma ne babalinnyisa waggulu ku ggolofa. Ku Ssande emu, Allen, Absalom Jones n'abalala bwe baali bafukamidde okusaba waggulu, omu ku bawanika n'akwata Jones n'agezaako okumusitula okuva mu kufukamira wakati mu kusaba. Okusaba bwe kwaggwa, abaddugavu ne bagolokoka wamu ne bafuluma olw'enkomerero — "tebaddamu kuteganyizibwa naffe mu kkanisa."

q: Ye ne Absalom Jones baakola ki mu musujja ogw'ekyenvu ogwa 1793?
a: Mu kyeya kya 1793 omusujja ogw'ekyenvu gwakuba Philadelphia; enkumi n'enkumi ne zifa, era abo abaali basobola ne badduka. Abasawo ne beegayirira abaddugavu okujjanjaba abalwadde n'okuziika abafu, nga balowooza ekitali kituufu nti abantu ab'ensibuko y'Afirika tebakwatibwa bulwadde obwo. Tebaali batyo, era bangi baafa, naye Allen ne Jones ne baddamu okukoowoola okwo, ne bategeka abaddugavu b'e Philadelphia okugenda buli nnyumba wakati w'abaali bafa. Omuwandiisi w'obutabo bwe yabavunaana oluvannyuma olw'okunoonya amagoba, baddamu mu Narrative yaabwe gye baafulumya, era Allen n'agattako obubaka obussa ensonga y'abaddu mu ngeri ya Katonda yennyini: "Katonda yennyini ye yasooka okuwolereza ensonga y'abaddu."

Mu 1794 Allen yagula edduuka lya muweesi ekkadde, n'alisikisa ku kibanja kye yalina ku Sixth Street, n'alifuula ennyumba y'okusinzizaamu; Francis Asbury yabuulira ku lunaku olw'okugiwaayo, era n'etuumibwa Bethel — "ennyumba ya Katonda." Abantu ne bagiyita Mother Bethel, era ekyayimiridde ne kaakano ku kibanja ekisinga obukadde ekyakuumibwa obutasalako Abaamerika Abaddugavu mu Amerika. Mu 1799 Asbury yawonga Allen okuba omudiikoni, omusajja omuddugavu asooka okuwongebwa bw'atyo mu Methodist Episcopal Church, newankubadde okwefuga kw'ekibiina kwali kukyalina okulwanirwa mu mbuga z'amateeka.

q: African Methodist Episcopal Church (AME) yatandikibwawo etya?
a: Olukiiko lw'abazungu lwagezaako emirundi n'emirundi okukomyawo Bethel wansi w'obuyinza bwalwo, era Allen n'ekibiina kye ne bagaana okumala emyaka mingi egy'entalo z'omu mbuga z'amateeka, okutuusa mu 1816 Pennsylvania Supreme Court bwe yakakasa obuyinza bwa Bethel okwefuga. Mu mwaka gwe gumu Allen yakuŋŋaanya amakuŋŋaaniro g'Abamesodisiti abaddugavu okuva e Philadelphia, e Baltimore n'awalala, era wamu ne batandikawo eddiini empya ddala — African Methodist Episcopal Church, eddiini esooka ey'abaddugavu eyeefuga mu bujjuvu mu Amerika. Nga April 11, 1816, Richard Allen yawongebwa okuba omulabirizi waayo omusooka.

Ng'omulabirizi, Allen yawaayo obulamu bwe obwasigalawo eri abantu abaali beezimba mu ddembe: yazimba amakuŋŋaaniro, n'awa ababuulizi olukusa, n'awakanya enteekateeka ez'okusindika Abaamerika Abaddugavu ab'eddembe mu Afirika, n'alwanirira okusomesa, n'akweka abaddukanga obuddu, era mu 1830 n'ayamba okukuŋŋaanya National Negro Convention esooka mu bisenge bya Mother Bethel. Yafa nga March 26, 1831, ng'aweza emyaka nsanvu mu gumu, era n'aziikibwa ku Mother Bethel. Ajjukirwa ng'omulabirizi, omutandisi, omulwanyi w'okumalawo obuddu, era omukulembeze w'eggwanga — naye eyasooka okwemanya ng'omuddu eyasanga ekisa ng'afukamidde, era ebirala byonna ne biva mu ekyo.
